_comment: Three ElevenLabs Voice Design prompts (2026-11-05). Same test text for all (test_text.txt). Previews only - nothing is saved as a permanent voice.

variants.label: Warm & Mysterious
variants.voice_description: A young American man in his early twenties with a warm, slightly raspy voice and a mid-range pitch. He tells mystery stories for YouTube Shorts in an intimate, hushed but clear way, with controlled suspense: he slows down on key words, leans into them, and lets the tension hang in short pauses. Natural and conversational, never theatrical. Clear articulation, neutral General American accent. Not deep, not a documentary narrator, not monotone or robotic. Studio-quality recording.

variants.label: Warm & Energetic
variants.voice_description: A young American man around twenty-one with a warm, slightly brighter, lightly raspy voice and a medium-high pitch. An energetic YouTube Shorts storyteller who sounds genuinely excited to share a strange true story: lively pacing, punchy emphasis, rising curiosity and a hint of a smile in his voice. Natural and conversational, clear articulation, General American accent. Not deep, not a documentary narrator, not monotone or robotic. Studio-quality recording.

variants.label: Warm & Cinematic
variants.voice_description: A charismatic young American man in his mid-twenties with a warm, slightly gravelly, distinctive voice and a mid-range pitch. A cinematic storyteller for YouTube Shorts with strong emotional range and dynamic emphasis: quiet and tense one moment, bold and gripping the next, landing big reveals with weight. Natural and confident, clear articulation, General American accent. Not a deep movie-trailer voice, not a documentary narrator, not monotone or robotic. Studio-quality recording.
